map.桥架选多大？输入电缆外径与根数，自动估算桥架宽高，并按常见填充率标准校验是否合适: What size tray? Input cable outer diameter and count to estimate tray width/height and check suitability against common fill-rate standards.
map.单根截面积 A₁ = π·D²/4；电缆总截面积 A = A₁·N；所需桥架面积: Single cable area A1 = pi x D^2/4; total cable area A = A1 x N; required tray area A_need = A / fill rate; recommended size is the smallest standard size meeting 'width x height >= A_need'; actual fill rate = A / (width x height) x 100%.
map.D 为单根电缆外径(mm)，N 为电缆根数；填充率按用途取 40%（动力）、50: D is single-cable outer diameter (mm), N is cable count; fill rate is 40% (power), 50% (control), etc. by usage. Area-based selection guarantees thermal margin and installation space.
map.按电缆外径与根数计算所需桥架截面积。: Compute the required tray cross-section area from cable outer diameter and count.
map.按填充率选型桥架宽×高规格。: Select tray width x height size by fill rate.
map.校核实际填充率是否满足散热与施工要求。: Verify the actual fill rate meets thermal and installation requirements.
map.总截面积约 785 mm²，按 40% 填充率需桥架面积约 1964 mm²，可: Total area ~ 785 mm2; at 40% fill rate the tray needs ~ 1964 mm2, so a 100 x 50 size fits with an actual fill rate ~ 15.7%.
map.电缆根数多、截面大时推荐 300×150 及以上规格，保证散热余量与后期扩容空间: With many cables and large sections, a 300 x 150 or larger size is recommended to ensure thermal margin and future expansion space.
map.填充率取多少合适？: What is a suitable fill rate?
map.动力电缆常取 40%，控制电缆可放宽至 50%；高温或需扩容场合宜更低。: Power cables commonly use 40%, control cables may relax to 50%; high-temperature or expandable cases should be lower.
map.为什么按面积而不是按根数选型？: Why size by area rather than by count?
map.同样根数不同直径占用空间差异大，按面积法能真实反映敷设所需空间。: The same count with different diameters occupies very different space; the area method truly reflects the required installation space.
map.桥架面积 = 电缆截面积之和 ÷ 填充率: Tray area = sum of cable cross-sections / fill rate
map.填充率：电力 40%、控制 50%、扩容预留 60%: Fill rate: power 40%, control 50%, expansion reserve 60%
map.选满足面积的最小标准规格: Choose the smallest standard size that meets the area
map.正式设计按 GB/T 29415 与散热校核执行: Formal design follows GB/T 29415 and thermal verification
